name: agent-resume-panel
description: Browse, search, and resume Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Pi, and Alma sessions from a VS Code sidebar — with ACP Chat, project filters, favorites, native session rename, and read-only chat preview.
author: thunder-luc

scripts.publish:openvsx: npm run build:all && npx --yes ovsx publish "dist/agent-resume-panel-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").vsix"

agentResume.codexHome.description: Codex home directory containing state_*.sqlite, session_index.jsonl, and history.jsonl.

agentResume.claudeHome.description: Claude Code home directory containing history.jsonl and projects.

agentResume.antigravityHome.description: Antigravity data root. The extension scans antigravity-cli and antigravity subdirectories for sessions.

agentResume.grokHome.description: Grok Build home directory containing sessions.

agentResume.almaDataDir.description: Alma data directory containing chat_threads.db. On macOS this is usually ~/Library/Application Support/alma.

agentResume.piHome.description: Pi agent home directory containing sessions.

agentResume.panelHome.description: Agent Resume Panel data directory for ACP chat sessions.

agentResume.catalog.dbPath.description: SQLite catalog database path. Empty uses <panelHome>/catalog.db.

agentResume.catalog.syncMaxItems.description: Maximum sessions per sync pass written into the catalog (per-provider loaders use this cap during sync).

agentResume.catalog.stalePolicy.description: When a session disappears from agent storage during sync: hide marks it hidden in the catalog; purge deletes the catalog row.

agentResume.catalog.sidebarMode.description: Sidebar session cap. legacy uses Max Sessions; full shows up to syncMaxItems.

agentResume.acp.autoApprovePermissions.description: How ACP Chat handles agent permission requests. ask shows a quick pick; allowAll auto-approves when possible.

agentResume.acp.agents.codex.command.description: Launch command for Codex ACP agent.

agentResume.acp.agents.codex.args.description: Launch arguments for Codex ACP agent.

agentResume.acp.agents.claude.command.description: Launch command for Claude ACP agent.

agentResume.acp.agents.claude.args.description: Launch arguments for Claude ACP agent.

agentResume.acp.agents.grok.command.description: Launch command for Grok ACP agent. Uses the locally installed Grok Build CLI (see https://x.ai/cli).

agentResume.acp.agents.grok.args.description: Launch arguments for Grok ACP agent.

agentResume.acp.agents.opencode.command.description: Launch command for OpenCode ACP agent.

agentResume.acp.agents.opencode.args.description: Launch arguments for OpenCode ACP agent.

agentResume.acp.agents.pi.command.description: Launch command for Pi ACP agent.

agentResume.acp.agents.pi.args.description: Launch arguments for Pi ACP agent.

agentResume.maxItems.description: Maximum number of sessions to load into the panel.

agentResume.terminalMode.description: Terminal launch behavior. The first version opens one terminal per resumed session.

agentResume.terminalLocation.description: Where VS Code integrated resume terminals should open.

agentResume.enableVsCodeTerminalImagesHi.description: Show a one-time hint about VS Code terminal image support and the Ghostty fallback.

agentResume.ghosttyExecutable.description: Ghostty app name on macOS or ghostty CLI executable/path used by Open in Ghostty.

agentResume.ghosttyLaunchMode.description: How Open in Ghostty starts a session. pasteCommand opens Ghostty, pastes the copied resume command, and presses Enter without using Ghostty's execute-command path.

agentResume.ghosttyAutoPasteDelayMs.description: Delay before auto-pasting the resume command into Ghostty when ghosttyLaunchMode is pasteCommand.

agentResume.showSubagentCodex.description: Show Codex subagent threads in the panel (threads whose source field contains subagent).

agentResume.showSubagentGrok.description: Show Grok Build subagent sessions (session_kind: subagent) in the panel. Ephemeral subagent shells with no title and at most one message are always hidden.

agentResume.hideCronAlma.description: Hide Alma cron threads (titles starting with ⏰ Cron:).

agentResume.hideChannelAlma.description: Hide Alma channel threads (WeChat, Telegram, Discord, Slack).

agentResume.showIncognitoAlma.description: Show Alma incognito threads in the panel.

agentResume.editorNewSessionProvider.description: CLI agent provider started by the editor title bar New Session button.

agentResume.claudeResumeMode.description: How Claude sessions resume from a click or Open Folder and Resume. panel opens the Claude Code VS Code extension; terminal uses the integrated terminal CLI (claude --resume).

agentResume.codexResumeMode.description: How Codex sessions resume from a click or Open Folder and Resume. terminal uses the integrated terminal CLI; panel uses the Codex VS Code extension (experimental); app uses Codex App.

agentResume.codexIdePanelResume.enabled.description: [Experimental] Enable Resume in Codex IDE Panel. Set to false to disable immediately if a Codex extension update breaks panel resume.

agentResume.codexIdePanelResume.implemen.description: [Experimental] Must match the Codex IDE panel integration version built into Agent Resume Panel (currently 1). Lower this only after updating the extension code for a new Codex routing scheme.

agentResume.llm.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for session summarize and auto-rename.

agentResume.llm.model.description: Model name for session summarize and auto-rename. Prefer a fast, inexpensive model when possible (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-chat).

agentResume.llm.outputLanguage.description: Language used for Summarize and Auto Rename results.

agentResume.llm.maxContextChars.description: Maximum characters of conversation sent to the LLM.

agentResume.projectMenu.mainActions.description: Project context menu items shown outside Show More. Array order is the preferred sequence. Open Folder is always visible.

agentResume.projectMenu.itemOrder.description: Preferred display order for all configurable project context menu actions.

agentResume.sessionMenu.mainActions.description: Session context menu items shown outside Show More. Array order is the preferred sequence. Open Folder is always visible.

agentResume.sessionMenu.itemOrder.description: Preferred display order for all configurable session context menu actions.
